io_schema.input_description: A patient record containing age in years, body mass index, and smoking status used to predict systolic blood pressure.

prompt_guidance.units: age_years in years, body_mass_index in kg_per_m2, systolic_blood_pressure_mm_hg in mmHg
allowed_hints: Use a normal likelihood for the continuous blood pressure outcome.
Use a simple additive linear predictor from the listed covariates.
forbidden_hints: Do not introduce patient-level random effects.
Do not use nonlinear splines or interaction terms.
Do not model medication classes or comorbidities not listed as covariates.
